meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 管理一组有先后依赖的任务：前一个完成后，后一个才开始。它会分阶段运行这些任务，某个任务失败时可用重试、改指令或中途指点来恢复，并产出每步的结果。
howto.when: 当用户提出使用 mass-ulw、任务 DAG，或需要某些任务等待其他任务的扇出工作时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 跑一个任务图：先审核代码，再修复问题，最后跑测试。
say.note: Claude 会按依赖顺序逐步执行各阶段。

say.text: 重试刚才任务图里失败的那个节点。
say.note: 只重跑失败节点，已完成的结果会保留。

say.text: 修改任务图里某个节点的指令，再重跑受影响的步骤。
say.note: 会通过 amend 只重跑被改节点和它的下游依赖。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to manage interdependent tasks as a dependency graph, running later tasks only after prior ones finish. Runs one phase at a time, and on node failure offers retry, amend, or send to recover. Produces each task's result.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Run a task graph with mass-ulw: first audit code, then fix issues, then run tests.
say_en.note: Claude executes each stage in dependency order.

say_en.text: Retry the failed node in that task graph.
say_en.note: Only failed nodes rerun; completed results are kept.

say_en.text: Edit one node's instructions in the task graph and rerun the affected parts.
say_en.note: Uses amend to rerun only changed nodes and their downstream dependents.
